statements.subject: server
statements.description: If no transport specification is supported, no transport header is returned and the response MUST use the status code 461 (Unsupported Transport).
statements.trigger: SETUP request with no supported transport specification

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST return a Transport response-header in the response to indicate the values actually chosen, if any.
statements.trigger: SETUP request with supported transport specification
actions: return Transport response-header with chosen transport specification

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the proxy results in no remaining transport specification after removing unknown parameters, the proxy SHALL send a 461 (Unsupported Transport) response without any Transport header.
statements.trigger: proxy forwards SETUP and all transport specifications contain unknown parameters

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server does not allow the host address part of the tuple to be set, it MUST return 463 (Destination Prohibited).
statements.trigger: SETUP request with disallowed dest_addr host address

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In response to a client SETUP request where the setup parameter is set to 'active', a server's 2xx reply MUST assign the setup parameter to 'passive' on the Transport header line.
actions: assign setup=passive in Transport response header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In response to a client SETUP request where the setup parameter is set to 'passive', a server's 2xx reply MUST assign the setup parameter to 'active' on the Transport header line.
actions: assign setup=active in Transport response header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In response to a client SETUP request where the setup parameter is set to 'actpass', a server's 2xx reply MUST assign the setup parameter to 'active' or 'passive' on the Transport header line.
actions: assign setup=active or setup=passive in Transport response header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a client SETUP request assigns the 'new' value to 'connection', the server response MUST also assign the 'new' value to 'connection' on the Transport line.
actions: assign connection=new in Transport response header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a client SETUP request assigns the 'existing' value to 'connection', the server response MUST assign a value of 'existing' or 'new' to 'connection' on the Transport line, at its discretion.
actions: assign connection=existing or connection=new in Transport response header

statements.subject: session
statements.description: unicast / multicast: This parameter is a mutually exclusive indication of whether unicast or multicast delivery will be attempted. One of the two values MUST be specified.
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of unicast or multicast must appear per transport-spec

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The argument provides the channel number to be used in the $ block and MUST be present [when interleaved parameter is specified].

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The ssrc parameter MUST NOT be specified in requests.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Note that the 'holdconn' value for setup is not defined for RTSP use, and MUST NOT appear on a Transport line.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Transport header MAY also be used in subsequent SETUP requests to change transport parameters. A server MAY refuse to change parameters of an existing stream.
statements.trigger: subsequent SETUP request to change transport parameters
actions: or refuse change of parameters for existing stream
